workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 亮度與事件率練習：取每團 N = 1.15×10¹¹ 個質子、n_b = 2808 團、f_rev = 11,245 Hz、γ = 7461、ε_n = 3.75 µm、β* = 0.55 m、交叉角因子 F = 0.84。對撞點束流尺寸 σ* = √(3.75×10⁻⁶×0.55/7461) = 1.66×10⁻⁵ m = 16.6 µm。亮度 L = N²·n_b·f_rev·γ/(4π·ε_n·β*)×F = 1.3225×10²²×2808×11245×7461/(2.59×10⁻⁵)×0.84 ≈ 1.0×10³⁴ cm⁻²s⁻¹。取非彈性截面 σ_inel = 80 mb = 8×10⁻²⁶ cm²，事件率 = L×σ = 8×10⁸ 次/秒；每秒交叉次數 = 2808×11,245 = 3.16×10⁷，所以每次交叉平均約 25 個事件（堆疊）。一小時的積分亮度 = 1.0×10³⁴×3600 = 3.6×10³⁷ cm⁻² = 36 pb⁻¹。束流儲存能量 = 2808×1.15×10¹¹×7×10¹² eV×1.602×10⁻¹⁹ = 362 MJ。數值為設計參數等級的教學假設，不代表任何特定運轉填充。
workedExample.textEn: Luminosity and event-rate exercise: take N = 1.15×10¹¹ protons per bunch, n_b = 2808 bunches, f_rev = 11,245 Hz, γ = 7461, ε_n = 3.75 µm, β* = 0.55 m and a crossing-angle factor F = 0.84. The beam size at the interaction point is σ* = √(3.75×10⁻⁶×0.55/7461) = 1.66×10⁻⁵ m = 16.6 µm. The luminosity L = N²·n_b·f_rev·γ/(4π·ε_n·β*)×F = 1.3225×10²²×2808×11245×7461/(2.59×10⁻⁵)×0.84 ≈ 1.0×10³⁴ cm⁻²s⁻¹. With an inelastic cross-section σ_inel = 80 mb = 8×10⁻²⁶ cm², the event rate is L×σ = 8×10⁸ per second; crossings per second are 2808×11,245 = 3.16×10⁷, so each crossing carries about 25 events on average (pile-up). One hour integrates 1.0×10³⁴×3600 = 3.6×10³⁷ cm⁻² = 36 pb⁻¹. The stored beam energy is 2808×1.15×10¹¹×7×10¹² eV×1.602×10⁻¹⁹ = 362 MJ. Values are teaching assumptions at the level of design parameters, not any particular operating fill.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表實機量測、產品額定或操作參數；改變系統邊界後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not measured hardware, product ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after changing the system boundary.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與設施背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and facility context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「磁剛度：能量、場強與彎轉半徑」與「亮度：流強、發射度與 β* 的競賽」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Magnetic rigidity: energy, field and bending radius" and "Luminosity: the contest of intensity, emittance and β*": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 磁剛度：能量、場強與彎轉半徑：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Magnetic rigidity: energy, field and bending radius: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「26.7 km 環與主偶極磁鐵」如何決定CERN 大型強子對撞機的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “26.7 km ring and main dipoles” determines the key performance of “CERN Large Hadron Collider”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 帶電粒子在磁場中的彎轉由磁剛度 Bρ = p/q 決定，對質子而言 Bρ [T·m] = 3.3356×p [GeV/c]。LHC 沿用 LEP 的 26,659 m 隧道，彎轉只能由 1232 顆磁長 14.3 m 的主偶極磁鐵提供，因此彎轉半徑被固定在約 2804 m，要把質子推到 7 TeV 就必須有 8.33 T 的偶極場，這遠超過鐵磁飽和的 2 T，只能靠超導線圈。對撞機的優勢在質心能量：兩束 7 TeV 對撞得到 √s = 14 TeV，而 7 TeV 質子打固定靶只有 √(2Em) ≈ 115 GeV。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「26.7 km 環與主偶極磁鐵」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Bending of a charged particle in a magnetic field is governed by the magnetic rigidity Bρ = p/q, which for protons reads Bρ [T·m] = 3.3356×p [GeV/c]. The LHC reuses the 26,659 m LEP tunnel, and all bending comes from 1232 main dipoles of 14.3 m magnetic length, so the bending radius is fixed near 2804 m; reaching 7 TeV therefore demands a dipole field of 8.33 T, far beyond the 2 T saturation of iron and achievable only with superconducting coils. The collider's advantage is centre-of-mass energy: two 7 TeV beams give √s = 14 TeV, whereas a 7 TeV proton on a fixed target yields only √(2Em) ≈ 115 GeV. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “26.7 km ring and main dipoles”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要隧道夠長，用普通電磁鐵也能達到 7 TeV。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "With a long enough tunnel ordinary electromagnets could reach 7 TeV." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「26.7 km 環與主偶極磁鐵」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “26.7 km ring and main dipoles”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

quiz.question: 關於「磁剛度：能量、場強與彎轉半徑」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Magnetic rigidity: energy, field and bending radius" is correct?

steps.title: 磁剛度：能量、場強與彎轉半徑：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Magnetic rigidity: energy, field and bending radius: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「26.7 km 環與主偶極磁鐵」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “26.7 km ring and main dipoles” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：Bρ = 3.3356×7000 = 23,349 T·m；ρ = 1232×14.3 m/(2π) = 2804 m；B = 23,349/2804 = 8.33 T。Run 3 的 6.8 TeV 對應 8.09 T。固定靶的質心能量 √(2×7000 GeV×0.938 GeV) = 114.6 GeV，比對撞的 14,000 GeV 小 122 倍。這說明對撞機設計必須用超導磁鐵在固定隧道內提高彎轉磁場，而非只提高束流能量。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Bρ = 3.3356×7000 = 23,349 T·m; ρ = 1232×14.3 m/(2π) = 2804 m; B = 23,349/2804 = 8.33 T. The 6.8 TeV of Run 3 corresponds to 8.09 T. The fixed-target centre-of-mass energy √(2×7000 GeV×0.938 GeV) = 114.6 GeV is 122 times smaller than the 14,000 GeV of collisions. This is why a collider in a fixed tunnel must raise the bending field with superconducting magnets rather than raise beam energy alone. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用偶極磁鐵的旋轉線圈磁量測資料（每顆磁鐵在 1.9 K 的傳遞函數，單位 T/kA）乘上運轉電流，加總 1232 顆的彎轉角是否恰為 2π；再由束流的迴旋頻率 11,245 Hz 與 RF 頻率反推軌道長度，與 26,659 m 比較，差異應在毫米等級。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Multiply each dipole's rotating-coil transfer function at 1.9 K (in T/kA) by the operating current and check that the 1232 bending angles sum to exactly 2π; then infer the orbit length from the 11,245 Hz revolution frequency and the RF frequency and compare with 26,659 m, where the difference should be at the millimetre level.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

quiz.question: 依「磁剛度：能量、場強與彎轉半徑」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Magnetic rigidity: energy, field and bending radius", which statement holds?

steps.title: 磁剛度：能量、場強與彎轉半徑：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Magnetic rigidity: energy, field and bending radius: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「26.7 km 環與主偶極磁鐵」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “26.7 km ring and main dipoles” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 用偶極磁鐵的旋轉線圈磁量測資料（每顆磁鐵在 1.9 K 的傳遞函數，單位 T/kA）乘上運轉電流，加總 1232 顆的彎轉角是否恰為 2π；再由束流的迴旋頻率 11,245 Hz 與 RF 頻率反推軌道長度，與 26,659 m 比較，差異應在毫米等級。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Multiply each dipole's rotating-coil transfer function at 1.9 K (in T/kA) by the operating current and check that the 1232 bending angles sum to exactly 2π; then infer the orbit length from the 11,245 Hz revolution frequency and the RF frequency and compare with 26,659 m, where the difference should be at the millimetre level. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：若磁鐵傳遞函數的校正偏差 10⁻³，所有偶極同向多彎，束流中心能量與 RF 鎖定的軌道長度不再一致，束流被迫沿徑向偏移以補償，最終撞上孔徑或在加速中失去。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A 10⁻³ calibration error in the dipole transfer function makes every dipole over-bend in the same direction; the beam's central energy no longer matches the RF-locked orbit length, the beam shifts radially to compensate and is eventually lost on the aperture or during the ramp.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用偶極磁鐵的旋轉線圈磁量測資料（每顆磁鐵在 1.9 K 的傳遞函數，單位 T/kA）乘上運轉電流，加總 1232 顆的彎轉角是否恰為 2π；再由束流的迴旋頻率 11,245 Hz 與 RF 頻率反推軌道長度，與 26,659 m 比較，差異應在毫米等級。

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「磁剛度：能量、場強與彎轉半徑」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Magnetic rigidity: energy, field and bending radius"?
options: 用偶極磁鐵的旋轉線圈磁量測資料（每顆磁鐵在 1.9 K 的傳遞函數，單位 T/kA）乘上運轉電流，加總 1232 顆的彎轉角是否恰為 2π。

Verification needs a reference, repeatability and acceptance criteria.

steps.title: 磁剛度：能量、場強與彎轉半徑：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Magnetic rigidity: energy, field and bending radius: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「26.7 km 環與主偶極磁鐵」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “26.7 km ring and main dipoles” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 若磁鐵傳遞函數的校正偏差 10⁻³，所有偶極同向多彎，束流中心能量與 RF 鎖定的軌道長度不再一致，束流被迫沿徑向偏移以補償，最終撞上孔徑或在加速中失去。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Luminosity formula and β* at the interaction point” determines the key performance of “CERN Large Hadron Collider”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 對撞機的產率由亮度決定：事件率 = L×σ。對於 n_b 個團、每團 N 個質子、迴旋頻率 f_rev、正規化發射度 ε_n、對撞點 β 函數 β* 的高斯束，L = N²·n_b·f_rev·γ/(4π·ε_n·β*)×F，F 是交叉角造成的幾何損失因子。亮度隨每團粒子數平方上升，所以注入鏈必須提供高亮度的團，同時 β* 要由最後一組三合一超導四極磁鐵壓到次公尺等級。對撞點束流尺寸 σ* = √(ε_n·β*/γ) 只有十幾微米，兩束必須以微米精度對準。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「亮度公式與對撞點 β*」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A collider's output is set by luminosity: event rate = L×σ. steps.title: 超導主偶極：線圈、預應力與淬火保護：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Superconducting main dipoles: coils, pre-stress and quench protection: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「NbTi 盧瑟福纜與雙孔徑冷質量」如何決定CERN 大型強子對撞機的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “NbTi Rutherford cable and twin-aperture cold mass” determines the key performance of “CERN Large Hadron Collider”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 每顆主偶極是一個「二合一」磁鐵：兩個 56 mm 孔徑的 cos θ 線圈裝在同一個鐵軛與低溫恆溫槽內，產生方向相反的場讓兩束反向迴旋。線圈由 NbTi 細絲嵌在銅基體中的盧瑟福纜繞成內外兩層，以沃斯田鐵不銹鋼箍環施加預應力，避免 8.33 T 下的勞侖茲力讓導體微動發熱而淬火。一旦某處失去超導，淬火偵測器在毫秒內觸發加熱片使整個線圈均勻轉為常導，並由二極體把電流旁路，讓儲存的磁能分散在整顆磁鐵而不是燒毀一小段導體。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「NbTi 盧瑟福纜與雙孔徑冷質量」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Each main dipole is a two-in-one magnet: two cos θ coils with 56 mm apertures share one iron yoke and cryostat and produce opposite fields so the two beams circulate in opposite directions. When superconductivity is lost anywhere, quench detection fires heaters within milliseconds to drive the whole coil normal and a bypass diode diverts the current, so the stored magnetic energy is spread over the entire magnet instead of burning a short length of conductor. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “NbTi Rutherford cable and twin-aperture cold mass”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：儲能 E = ½LI²：取單顆偶極電感 98.7 mH、I = 11,850 A，E = 0.5×0.0987×11850² ≈ 6.9 MJ，1232 顆合計約 8.5 GJ。磁壓 B²/(2μ₀) = 8.33²/(2×4π×10⁻⁷) ≈ 27.6 MPa，相當於 276 bar 向外推線圈，這就是箍環預應力必須承受的量級。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。

steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: On the cold test bench ramp each magnet above nominal current and record the training curve of quench currents, confirming that after a few quenches it reliably exceeds 8.33 T; measure the multipole content (b₃, b₅ in units of 10⁻⁴) with rotating coils, and record the peak coil temperature and voltage during a quench to confirm that heaters and diodes keep the hot spot below about 300 K.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。

steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。

steps.objective: 說明「1.9 K 超流氦熱交換管」如何決定CERN 大型強子對撞機的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “1.9 K superfluid-helium heat-exchanger tube” determines the key performance of “CERN Large Hadron Collider”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: LHC 把 NbTi 磁鐵冷到 1.9 K 而不是 4.2 K，因為臨界電流密度隨溫度下降而上升，讓同樣的導體在 8.33 T 仍有餘裕。低於 2.17 K 的氦成為超流氦 He II，有效熱導極高、黏度極低，能滲進線圈絕緣帶走熱量；每顆磁鐵的冷質量浸在 1.9 K、1.3 bar 的靜態 He II 中，熱量再經由穿過磁鐵的貝氏熱交換管傳給 16 mbar 的兩相飽和 He II。八座 4.5 K 製冷站各約 18 kW，加上 1.8 K 冷壓縮機單元，維持約 36,000 噸冷質量與 120 噸氦；束流造成的同步輻射、影像電流與電子雲熱負載則由 5 K 到 20 K 的束流屏截住，不進入 1.9 K。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「1.9 K 超流氦熱交換管」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The LHC cools its NbTi magnets to 1.9 K rather than 4.2 K because critical current density rises as temperature falls, giving the same conductor margin at 8.33 T. stages.description: 本階段聚焦「軌道、光學量測與磁場校正」與「機器保護：準直、束流損失與淬火預算」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。

steps.title: 軌道、光學量測與磁場校正：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Orbit, optics measurement and magnetic-field calibration: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「束流位置監測器與磁鐵場模型」如何決定CERN 大型強子對撞機的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Beam-position monitors and magnet field model” determines the key performance of “CERN Large Hadron Collider”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 環上約一千組束流位置監測器（BPM）在每一圈量兩束的位置，軌道回授用數百顆校正磁鐵把閉軌壓到次毫米；調諧值由 BBQ 系統從束流的微小振盪頻譜讀出，色品度則以調變 RF 頻率、觀察調諧變化量測。光學函數 β 的誤差（β-beating）用 AC 偶極激發束流做逐圈量測再反解。超導磁鐵在注入能量 450 GeV 時持續電流會隨時間衰減、在升流開始時又「回彈」，改變六極場分量 b₃，因此必須以參考磁鐵的量測建立場模型，前饋修正六極校正磁鐵。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「束流位置監測器與磁鐵場模型」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: About a thousand beam-position monitors read both beams every turn and an orbit feedback uses hundreds of corrector magnets to hold the closed orbit to sub-millimetre; the tune is read by the BBQ system from the spectrum of tiny beam oscillations, and chromaticity is measured by modulating the RF frequency and watching the tune shift. Errors in the beta function (beta-beating) are measured turn by turn with an AC dipole exciting the beam and then inverted. In superconducting magnets at the 450 GeV injection energy, persistent currents decay with time and snap back when the ramp starts, changing the sextupole component b₃, so a field model built from reference-magnet measurements feeds corrections forward to the sextupole correctors. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Beam-position monitors and magnet field model”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：一顆偶極的彎轉角 2π/1232 = 5.1 mrad；1 單位（10⁻⁴）的場誤差產生 0.51 µrad 的踢角。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: One dipole bends by 2π/1232 = 5.1 mrad, so a 1-unit (10⁻⁴) field error gives a 0.51 µrad kick.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「超導磁鐵的場只由電流決定，與時間和歷史無關。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A superconducting magnet's field is set by current alone, independent of time and history." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「束流位置監測器與磁鐵場模型」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Beam-position monitors and magnet field model”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 軌道、光學量測與磁場校正：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Orbit, optics measurement and magnetic-field calibration: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「束流位置監測器與磁鐵場模型」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Beam-position monitors and magnet field model” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：一顆偶極的彎轉角 2π/1232 = 5.1 mrad；1 單位（10⁻⁴）的場誤差產生 0.51 µrad 的踢角。閉軌畸變峰值 ≈ θ√(β_i β_j)/(2 sin πQ)，取 β = 100 m、Q 的分數部分 0.31：0.51×10⁻⁶×100/(2×0.827) ≈ 31 µm。這是單顆磁鐵的量級，1232 顆隨機誤差則以均方根累加成毫米等級，必須校正。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: One dipole bends by 2π/1232 = 5.1 mrad, so a 1-unit (10⁻⁴) field error gives a 0.51 µrad kick. The peak closed-orbit distortion ≈ θ√(β_i β_j)/(2 sin πQ); with β = 100 m and a fractional tune of 0.31, 0.51×10⁻⁶×100/(2×0.827) ≈ 31 µm. That is one magnet; the random errors of 1232 dipoles add in quadrature to the millimetre level and must be corrected. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：注入後比較 BPM 量到的閉軌與模型預測，用奇異值分解把校正磁鐵的響應矩陣反解，施加修正後確認軌道均方根小於 0.5 mm；在注入平台上每 100 s 量一次色品度，確認 b₃ 衰減的前饋修正把色品度維持在設定值 ±2 以內。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: After injection compare the BPM closed orbit with the model, invert the corrector response matrix by singular-value decomposition, apply the correction and confirm an rms orbit below 0.5 mm; on the injection plateau measure chromaticity every 100 s and confirm that the feed-forward for b₃ decay keeps it within ±2 of the set value.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 軌道、光學量測與磁場校正：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Orbit, optics measurement and magnetic-field calibration: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「束流位置監測器與磁鐵場模型」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Beam-position monitors and magnet field model” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 注入後比較 BPM 量到的閉軌與模型預測，用奇異值分解把校正磁鐵的響應矩陣反解，施加修正後確認軌道均方根小於 0.5 mm；在注入平台上每 100 s 量一次色品度，確認 b₃ 衰減的前饋修正把色品度維持在設定值 ±2 以內。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：若回彈補償的時間模型錯誤，升流開始時色品度在幾秒內跳變數十單位，頭尾不穩定性被激發，束流損失觸發束流傾卸，整個填充作廢並損失數小時。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If the timing model of snapback compensation is wrong, chromaticity jumps by tens of units within seconds of the ramp starting, head-tail instabilities develop, beam losses trigger a dump and the whole fill is lost along with several hours.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

steps.instruction: 若回彈補償的時間模型錯誤，升流開始時色品度在幾秒內跳變數十單位，頭尾不穩定性被激發，束流損失觸發束流傾卸，整個填充作廢並損失數小時。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。

steps.title: 機器保護：準直、束流損失與淬火預算：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Machine protection: collimation, beam loss and quench budgets: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「準直器顎板與束流損失監測器」如何決定CERN 大型強子對撞機的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Collimator jaws and beam-loss monitors” determines the key performance of “CERN Large Hadron Collider”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 設計值下每束儲存 362 MJ，足以熔化約 700 kg 銅，而超導線圈只要吸收每立方公分數十毫焦的瞬間能量就會淬火，因此只有極小比例的束流可以在磁鐵附近損失。多級準直系統在 IR7 做橫向清除、IR3 做動量清除：主準直器以碳纖維複合材料顎板放在約 5 到 6 倍束流尺寸處攔截暈粒子，次級準直器與吸收器再接住散射產物，清除效率須達 99.99% 以上。環上約四千個游離室束流損失監測器以 40 µs 到 1.3 s 的多個時間窗持續積分，任何通道超過閾值就在三圈內觸發束流傾卸：踢磁鐵在 3 µs 的空檔中把束流引出，掃過 7 m 長的石墨傾卸塊分散能量。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「準直器顎板與束流損失監測器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: At design values each beam stores 362 MJ, enough to melt about 700 kg of copper, while a superconducting coil quenches after absorbing only tens of millijoules per cubic centimetre in a fast loss, so only a tiny fraction of the beam may be lost near magnets. A multi-stage collimation system cleans the betatron halo in IR7 and the momentum halo in IR3: primary collimators with carbon-fibre-composite jaws at about 5 to 6 beam sigmas intercept halo particles, secondary collimators and absorbers catch the scattered products, and the cleaning efficiency must exceed 99.99 percent. Some four thousand ionization-chamber beam-loss monitors integrate over several windows from 40 µs to 1.3 s, and any channel above threshold triggers a beam dump within three turns: kicker magnets extract the beam during a 3 µs gap and sweep it over a 7 m graphite dump block to spread the energy. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Collimator jaws and beam-loss monitors”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Beam energy = n_b×N×E = 2808×1.15×10¹¹×7 TeV×1.602×10⁻¹⁹ J/eV = 3.62×10⁸ J.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「束流管內是真空，損失的質子不會造成任何傷害。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The beam pipe is a vacuum, so lost protons do no harm." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.

steps.title: 機器保護：準直、束流損失與淬火預算：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Machine protection: collimation, beam loss and quench budgets: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「準直器顎板與束流損失監測器」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Collimator jaws and beam-loss monitors” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：束流能量 = n_b×N×E = 2808×1.15×10¹¹×7 TeV×1.602×10⁻¹⁹ J/eV = 3.62×10⁸ J。銅從 300 K 升到熔點並熔化約需 505 kJ/kg，362 MJ 可熔化約 717 kg。若快速損失 10⁹ 個 7 TeV 質子（1.1 kJ）就可能淬火一顆磁鐵，這相當於束流的 3×10⁻⁶，所以準直系統的洩漏率必須遠低於 10⁻⁵。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Beam energy = n_b×N×E = 2808×1.15×10¹¹×7 TeV×1.602×10⁻¹⁹ J/eV = 3.62×10⁸ J. Heating copper from 300 K to its melting point and melting it takes about 505 kJ/kg, so 362 MJ melts about 717 kg. If a fast loss of 10⁹ protons at 7 TeV (1.1 kJ) can quench a magnet, that is 3×10⁻⁶ of the beam, so the collimation leakage must stay far below 10⁻⁵. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：做損失圖（loss map）：以橫向激發刻意讓束流暈增長，記錄環上每個束流損失監測器的讀數，確認最高損失集中在準直區且冷區的損失低於準直區峰值的 10⁻⁵；另外以低強度束流測試傾卸系統，核對踢磁鐵的同步與傾卸塊上的束流掃描軌跡。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Produce loss maps: deliberately grow the beam halo with transverse excitation, record every beam-loss monitor around the ring, and confirm that losses peak in the collimation regions while cold-region losses stay below 10⁻⁵ of that peak; separately test the dump system with low-intensity beam, checking kicker synchronization and the swept beam trace on the dump block.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 機器保護：準直、束流損失與淬火預算：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Machine protection: collimation, beam loss and quench budgets: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「準直器顎板與束流損失監測器」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Collimator jaws and beam-loss monitors” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 做損失圖（loss map）：以橫向激發刻意讓束流暈增長，記錄環上每個束流損失監測器的讀數，確認最高損失集中在準直區且冷區的損失低於準直區峰值的 10⁻⁵；另外以低強度束流測試傾卸系統，核對踢磁鐵的同步與傾卸塊上的束流掃描軌跡。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Produce loss maps: deliberately grow the beam halo with transverse excitation, record every beam-loss monitor around the ring, and confirm that losses peak in the collimation regions while cold-region losses stay below 10⁻⁵ of that peak; separately test the dump system with low-intensity beam, checking kicker synchronization and the swept beam trace on the dump block. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：準直器顎板若因對準誤差退到 8 σ 以外，暈粒子直接打到三合一四極磁鐵，束流損失監測器在數毫秒內超過閾值而傾卸束流；若監測器閾值設定過高，則磁鐵淬火、扇區升溫，恢復需數天。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If a misaligned collimator jaw retreats beyond 8 σ, halo particles strike the triplet quadrupoles directly and the beam-loss monitors exceed threshold within milliseconds and dump the beam; if the thresholds were set too high instead, a magnet quenches, the sector warms up and recovery takes days.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

steps.title: 機器保護：準直、束流損失與淬火預算：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Machine protection: collimation, beam loss and quench budgets: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「準直器顎板與束流損失監測器」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Collimator jaws and beam-loss monitors” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 準直器顎板若因對準誤差退到 8 σ 以外，暈粒子直接打到三合一四極磁鐵，束流損失監測器在數毫秒內超過閾值而傾卸束流；若監測器閾值設定過高，則磁鐵淬火、扇區升溫，恢復需數天。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: If a misaligned collimator jaw retreats beyond 8 σ, halo particles strike the triplet quadrupoles directly and the beam-loss monitors exceed threshold within milliseconds and dump the beam; if the thresholds were set too high instead, a magnet quenches, the sector warms up and recovery takes days. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：環上約四千個游離室束流損失監測器以 40 µs 到 1.3 s 的多個時間窗持續積分，任何通道超過閾值就在三圈內觸發束流傾卸：踢磁鐵在 3 µs 的空檔中把束流引出，掃過 7 m 長的石墨傾卸塊分散能量。

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「束流管內是真空，損失的質子不會造成任何傷害。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The beam pipe is a vacuum, so lost protons do no harm." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 注入、加速斜坡與 RF 系統整合：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Injection, energy ramp and RF-system integration: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「注入鏈與 400 MHz 射頻系統」如何決定CERN 大型強子對撞機的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Injector chain and 400 MHz RF system” determines the key performance of “CERN Large Hadron Collider”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 質子由 Linac4 的 160 MeV H⁻ 經 PS Booster 2 GeV、PS 26 GeV、SPS 450 GeV 逐級加速，SPS 分 12 批注入每個環，填滿約需 4 分 20 秒。每束由 4 個低溫模組內的 8 個 400.8 MHz 超導腔提供每腔 2 MV、共 16 MV 的電壓；這個電壓主要用來建立縱向的「桶」把粒子束縛成 1 ns 左右的團，真正的加速增量很小。升流時偶極電流從約 760 A 升到 11,850 A 約需 20 分鐘，RF 頻率隨速度微調，之後把 β* 從注入的 11 m 壓縮到 0.55 m 並把兩束對撞。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「注入鏈與 400 MHz 射頻系統」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Protons from Linac4 at 160 MeV (as H⁻) are accelerated in turn by the PS Booster to 2 GeV, the PS to 26 GeV and the SPS to 450 GeV; the SPS injects 12 batches into each ring and filling takes about 4 minutes 20 seconds. Each beam is driven by 8 superconducting 400.8 MHz cavities in 4 cryomodules at 2 MV each, 16 MV in total; this voltage mainly builds the longitudinal bucket that confines particles into bunches of about 1 ns, and the actual acceleration increment is tiny. During the ramp the dipole current rises from about 760 A to 11,850 A in roughly 20 minutes while the RF frequency tracks the velocity, after which β* is squeezed from 11 m at injection to 0.55 m and the beams are brought into collision. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Injector chain and 400 MHz RF system”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：諧波數 h = f_RF/f_rev = 400.79×10⁶/11,245 = 35,640；25 ns 的團間距等於 10 個 RF 桶，所以最多 3564 個團，注入踢磁鐵與傾卸空檔使實際上限為 2808。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Harmonic number h = f_RF/f_rev = 400.79×10⁶/11,245 = 35,640; a 25 ns bunch spacing equals 10 RF buckets, so at most 3564 bunches, and the injection-kicker and dump gaps reduce the practical limit to 2808.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「16 MV 的 RF 電壓是用來把質子從 450 GeV 加速到 7 TeV 的主要動力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The 16 MV of RF is the main power that accelerates protons from 450 GeV to 7 TeV." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「注入鏈與 400 MHz 射頻系統」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Injector chain and 400 MHz RF system”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

quiz.question: 關於「注入、加速斜坡與 RF 系統整合」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

steps.title: 注入、加速斜坡與 RF 系統整合：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Injection, energy ramp and RF-system integration: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「注入鏈與 400 MHz 射頻系統」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Injector chain and 400 MHz RF system” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：諧波數 h = f_RF/f_rev = 400.79×10⁶/11,245 = 35,640；25 ns 的團間距等於 10 個 RF 桶，所以最多 3564 個團，注入踢磁鐵與傾卸空檔使實際上限為 2808。升流 20 分鐘內能量增加 6.55 TeV，每圈只需 6.55×10¹²/(1200×11,245) ≈ 0.49 MeV，遠小於 16 MV 的 RF 電壓。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Harmonic number h = f_RF/f_rev = 400.79×10⁶/11,245 = 35,640; a 25 ns bunch spacing equals 10 RF buckets, so at most 3564 bunches, and the injection-kicker and dump gaps reduce the practical limit to 2808. Over a 20-minute ramp the energy rises by 6.55 TeV, requiring only 6.55×10¹²/(1200×11,245) ≈ 0.49 MeV per turn, far below the 16 MV RF voltage. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以壁電流監測器量團的縱向輪廓與長度，確認注入時 SPS 與 LHC 的 RF 相位同步使團落在桶中心、注入後無縱向振盪；升流中記錄束流流強與發射度，確認損失小於 1% 且發射度膨脹小於 10%。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure bunch profiles and lengths with a wall-current monitor, confirming that SPS and LHC RF phases are synchronized at injection so bunches land at bucket centre without longitudinal oscillation; during the ramp log intensity and emittance to confirm losses below 1 percent and emittance growth below 10 percent.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設；套用到實際設備前，必須重新取得規格、操作條件與不確定度。

steps.title: 注入、加速斜坡與 RF 系統整合：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Injection, energy ramp and RF-system integration: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「注入鏈與 400 MHz 射頻系統」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Injector chain and 400 MHz RF system” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 以壁電流監測器量團的縱向輪廓與長度，確認注入時 SPS 與 LHC 的 RF 相位同步使團落在桶中心、注入後無縱向振盪；升流中記錄束流流強與發射度，確認損失小於 1% 且發射度膨脹小於 10%。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure bunch profiles and lengths with a wall-current monitor, confirming that SPS and LHC RF phases are synchronized at injection so bunches land at bucket centre without longitudinal oscillation; during the ramp log intensity and emittance to confirm losses below 1 percent and emittance growth below 10 percent. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：注入時 RF 相位誤差幾度，團在桶內做大幅同步振盪，部分粒子溢出桶外成為未被捕獲的「幽靈」電荷，在傾卸空檔中被踢磁鐵部分偏轉而損失在孔徑上，觸發保護系統。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A phase error of a few degrees at injection makes the bunches execute large synchrotron oscillations, some particles spill out of the bucket as uncaptured ghost charge, get partially deflected by the kickers in the dump gap and are lost on the aperture, triggering the protection system.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以壁電流監測器量團的縱向輪廓與長度，確認注入時 SPS 與 LHC 的 RF 相位同步使團落在桶中心、注入後無縱向振盪；升流中記錄束流流強與發射度，確認損失小於 1% 且發射度膨脹小於 10%。
knowledge.textEn: Measure bunch profiles and lengths with a wall-current monitor, confirming that SPS and LHC RF phases are synchronized at injection so bunches land at bucket centre without longitudinal oscillation; during the ramp log intensity and emittance to confirm losses below 1 percent and emittance growth below 10 percent.

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「注入、加速斜坡與 RF 系統整合」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Injection, energy ramp and RF-system integration"?
options: 以壁電流監測器量團的縱向輪廓與長度，確認注入時 SPS 與 LHC 的 RF 相位同步使團落在桶中心、注入後無縱向振盪。
量測時不必記錄溫度、振動與時間等條件，因為它們不會影響結果。
超導磁鐵的場只由電流決定，與時間和歷史無關。
optionsEn: Measure bunch profiles and lengths with a wall-current monitor, confirming that SPS and LHC RF phases are synchronized at injection so bunches land at bucket centre without longitudinal oscillation.

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「硬體試運轉與電路驗收表」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Hardware commissioning and circuit acceptance sheet” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：接頭功率 P = I²R：I = 11,850 A 時，R = 1 nΩ 給 0.14 W，可由 He II 帶走；R = 220 nΩ 則為 31 W，遠超局部冷卻能力，銅穩定層會在數秒內升溫到失去超導並電弧。因此驗收標準把接頭電阻上限訂在數 nΩ，整個電路 1232 顆磁鐵的接頭總電阻也只有微歐等級。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Splice power P = I²R: at I = 11,850 A, R = 1 nΩ gives 0.14 W, which He II removes easily, whereas R = 220 nΩ gives 31 W, far beyond local cooling, so the copper stabilizer warms within seconds, loses superconductivity and arcs. Acceptance therefore caps splice resistance at a few nanoohms, and the total splice resistance of a 1232-magnet circuit is only at the microohm level. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在 1.9 K 用高精度電壓量測在接頭兩端讀取電壓降，除以電流得到 nΩ 級電阻，與 1 nΩ 等級的驗收上限比較；室溫下再用量測銅穩定層連續性的方法檢查每個接頭的焊接品質，所有數據存入電路資料庫並在交接前由機器保護小組簽核。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: At 1.9 K read the voltage drop across each splice with high-resolution voltmeters and divide by the current to obtain the nanoohm resistance, comparing with the acceptance limit of the order of 1 nΩ; at room temperature check the soldering quality of each splice by measuring the continuity of the copper stabilizer, and store all data in the circuit database for sign-off by the machine-protection team before handoff.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
